exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.generalNotes: Position the pad over the hips and the feet flat so the knees reach about 90 degrees at the top. Drive through the heels to full hip extension while keeping the spine and torso rigid rather than extending the lower back. Control the eccentric.
exercises.instructions: Pause for a second at the top; keep the ribs stacked.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.generalNotes: Use the lowest and narrowest stance your anatomy allows to maximize knee flexion. Keep the torso supported and the knees stable, descend under control, and drive the full foot into the platform to stand. Inhale during the descent, exhale on the ascent, and use a belt when loads become heavy if appropriate.
exercises.instructions: Feet mid-platform; sit deep while keeping the lower back on the pad.

exercises.name: B-Stance Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.generalNotes: Place one foot slightly behind as a kickstand without loading it; keep nearly all weight on the front leg. Use one or two dumbbells depending on balance, and support yourself with the free hand if using one dumbbell. Push the hips back and lower the dumbbell along the outside of the working leg only as far as mobility allows. Keep the torso rigid and look down to maintain a neutral neck.
exercises.instructions: Most of the weight on the front leg; hinge until you feel the stretch.

exercises.name: Cable Hip Abduction
exercises.generalNotes: Set the cable at ankle height and attach the outer leg with a cuff while standing side-on to the tower. Step far enough away to keep tension at the start while retaining support with the near hand. Move the working leg laterally with a small fixed knee bend, keeping the limb rigid and the load light enough for full range.
exercises.instructions: Lean slightly into the cable and move only at the hip.

exercises.name: Lean-Away Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Lead with the elbow and stop just above shoulder height.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.instructions: Press in a comfortable range without flaring the ribs.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull the elbows towards the hips and keep the chest tall.

exercises.name: Low Row Machine
exercises.instructions: Pause with the shoulder blades drawn back.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly Machine
exercises.generalNotes: Set the seat so the handles align with the shoulders. Keep the neck and torso neutral, and hold the arms straight or with a small fixed elbow bend. Move the arms backward using the posterior deltoids and shoulder-blade retraction, with a slow, controlled tempo.
exercises.instructions: Sweep the arms wide without shrugging.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
exercises.generalNotes: Hinge at the hips by pushing them backward as the torso lowers. Keep the spine rigid, use only a small knee bend, lower only as far as mobility allows, and move slowly.
exercises.instructions: Push the hips back and keep the bar close to the legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lunge
exercises.generalNotes: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step forward far enough to reach at least a 90-degree knee angle; a smaller angle creates more knee flexion and quadriceps emphasis. Keep most of the load on the front leg, use the rear leg only for balance, and allow a slight forward torso lean. Lower under control, drive through the front foot to return, and keep the knees tracking steadily without collapsing inward or outward.
exercises.instructions: Long stride, slight forward lean, drive through the front heel.

exercises.name: 45-Degree Hip Extension
exercises.instructions: Round the upper back slightly and squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.generalNotes: Press the hips firmly into the pad and keep the torso and thighs still. Curl the lower legs fully toward the hamstrings, then return slowly to full knee extension without lifting the hips.
exercises.instructions: Keep the hips pressed into the pad and control the return.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.generalNotes: Set the start position as wide as your mobility allows; use your hands to bring one pad inward if needed to enter safely. Anchor yourself with the handles and bring the knees together through the full range until the pads meet. Use partial repetitions only after full repetitions are no longer possible, and control the eccentric.
exercises.instructions: Use a smooth range and pause briefly when the pads meet.

exercises.name: Seated Lateral Raise Machine
exercises.instructions: Keep tension at the bottom; no swinging.

exercises.name: High-Incline Smith Machine Press
exercises.generalNotes: Set the bench to about 70 degrees inside the Smith machine.
exercises.instructions: Bench at a high incline; lower the bar to the upper chest.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Pull towards the forehead and rotate the hands back.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Lat Pulldown
exercises.generalNotes: Use a D-handle and pull the working elbow toward the same-side hip while keeping the torso stable.
exercises.instructions: Reach long at the top and pull the elbow to the hip.

exercises.name: Rope Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Keep the elbows high and still as the arms extend.

exercises.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
exercises.generalNotes: Use two D-handles and set the cables around calf height so tension remains at full elbow extension. Stand stable with a slight forward torso lean. Keep the elbows fixed, curl from a fully extended position, and keep the wrists neutral and steady. Use a slow, controlled tempo.
exercises.instructions: Let the arm stretch behind the body before each curl.

prescription.name: Face Pull
prescription.instructions: Pull towards the forehead and rotate the hands back.

prescription.name: Single-Arm Cable Lat Pulldown
prescription.generalNotes: Use a D-handle and pull the working elbow toward the same-side hip while keeping the torso stable.
prescription.instructions: Reach long at the top and pull the elbow to the hip.

prescription.name: Rope Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
prescription.instructions: Keep the elbows high and still as the arms extend.

prescription.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
prescription.generalNotes: Use two D-handles and set the cables around calf height so tension remains at full elbow extension. Stand stable with a slight forward torso lean. Keep the elbows fixed, curl from a fully extended position, and keep the wrists neutral and steady. Use a slow, controlled tempo.
prescription.instructions: Let the arm stretch behind the body before each curl.

prescription.name: Hip Thrust Machine
prescription.generalNotes: Position the pad over the hips and the feet flat so the knees reach about 90 degrees at the top. Drive through the heels to full hip extension while keeping the spine and torso rigid rather than extending the lower back. Control the eccentric.
prescription.instructions: Pause for a second at the top; keep the ribs stacked.

prescription.name: Hack Squat
prescription.generalNotes: Use the lowest and narrowest stance your anatomy allows to maximize knee flexion. Keep the torso supported and the knees stable, descend under control, and drive the full foot into the platform to stand. Inhale during the descent, exhale on the ascent, and use a belt when loads become heavy if appropriate.
prescription.instructions: Feet mid-platform; sit deep while keeping the lower back on the pad.

prescription.name: B-Stance Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
prescription.generalNotes: Place one foot slightly behind as a kickstand without loading it; keep nearly all weight on the front leg. Use one or two dumbbells depending on balance, and support yourself with the free hand if using one dumbbell. Push the hips back and lower the dumbbell along the outside of the working leg only as far as mobility allows. Keep the torso rigid and look down to maintain a neutral neck.
prescription.instructions: Most of the weight on the front leg; hinge until you feel the stretch.

prescription.name: Glute Kickback Machine
prescription.generalNotes: Support the torso on the pad and place the working foot on the platform. Drive the foot into the platform to extend the leg, reaching full extension at the top and a deep controlled bend at the bottom. Keep the tempo slow.
prescription.instructions: Drive through the heel without arching the lower back.

prescription.name: Cable Hip Abduction
prescription.generalNotes: Set the cable at ankle height and attach the outer leg with a cuff while standing side-on to the tower. Step far enough away to keep tension at the start while retaining support with the near hand. Move the working leg laterally with a small fixed knee bend, keeping the limb rigid and the load light enough for full range.
prescription.instructions: Lean slightly into the cable and move only at the hip.

prescription.name: Lean-Away Cable Lateral Raise
prescription.instructions: Lead with the elbow and stop just above shoulder height.

prescription.name: Shoulder Press Machine
prescription.instructions: Press in a comfortable range without flaring the ribs.

prescription.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
prescription.instructions: Pull the elbows towards the hips and keep the chest tall.

prescription.name: Low Row Machine
prescription.instructions: Pause with the shoulder blades drawn back.

prescription.name: Reverse Fly Machine
prescription.generalNotes: Set the seat so the handles align with the shoulders. Keep the neck and torso neutral, and hold the arms straight or with a small fixed elbow bend. Move the arms backward using the posterior deltoids and shoulder-blade retraction, with a slow, controlled tempo.
prescription.instructions: Sweep the arms wide without shrugging.

prescription.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
prescription.generalNotes: Hinge at the hips by pushing them backward as the torso lowers. Keep the spine rigid, use only a small knee bend, lower only as far as mobility allows, and move slowly.
prescription.instructions: Push the hips back and keep the bar close to the legs.

prescription.name: Dumbbell Lunge
prescription.generalNotes: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step forward far enough to reach at least a 90-degree knee angle; a smaller angle creates more knee flexion and quadriceps emphasis. Keep most of the load on the front leg, use the rear leg only for balance, and allow a slight forward torso lean. Lower under control, drive through the front foot to return, and keep the knees tracking steadily without collapsing inward or outward.
prescription.instructions: Long stride, slight forward lean, drive through the front heel.

prescription.name: 45-Degree Hip Extension
prescription.instructions: Round the upper back slightly and squeeze the glutes at the top.

prescription.name: Lying Leg Curl
prescription.generalNotes: Press the hips firmly into the pad and keep the torso and thighs still. Curl the lower legs fully toward the hamstrings, then return slowly to full knee extension without lifting the hips.
prescription.instructions: Keep the hips pressed into the pad and control the return.

prescription.name: Hip Adduction Machine
prescription.generalNotes: Set the start position as wide as your mobility allows; use your hands to bring one pad inward if needed to enter safely. Anchor yourself with the handles and bring the knees together through the full range until the pads meet. Use partial repetitions only after full repetitions are no longer possible, and control the eccentric.
prescription.instructions: Use a smooth range and pause briefly when the pads meet.

prescription.name: Seated Lateral Raise Machine
prescription.instructions: Keep tension at the bottom; no swinging.

prescription.name: High-Incline Smith Machine Press
prescription.generalNotes: Set the bench to about 70 degrees inside the Smith machine.
prescription.instructions: Bench at a high incline; lower the bar to the upper chest.

prescription.name: Face Pull
prescription.instructions: Pull towards the forehead and rotate the hands back.

prescription.name: Single-Arm Cable Lat Pulldown
prescription.generalNotes: Use a D-handle and pull the working elbow toward the same-side hip while keeping the torso stable.
prescription.instructions: Reach long at the top and pull the elbow to the hip.

prescription.name: Rope Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
prescription.instructions: Keep the elbows high and still as the arms extend.

prescription.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
prescription.generalNotes: Use two D-handles and set the cables around calf height so tension remains at full elbow extension. Stand stable with a slight forward torso lean. Keep the elbows fixed, curl from a fully extended position, and keep the wrists neutral and steady. Use a slow, controlled tempo.
prescription.instructions: Let the arm stretch behind the body before each curl.
